}}'''Andreas''' is is an quest-exclusive NPC in {{Location|Rinascita}} who first appears in {{Quest|Through the Sea Thou Break}}.

==Profile==
Andreas is first seen being forced to embark on the [[Pilgrim's Sail]]. After the ship wrecks on [[Penitent's End]] Island, he is rescued by [[Brant]], and joins the [[Troupe of Fools]].
